rules: Every badge is earned from logged activity or verified evidence records, never from a readiness score or percentage.
Tier = number of lit chevrons: bronze 1, silver 2, gold 3.
visibility "private": band-based badges are never shown to employers or on shared profiles.
visibility "student-choice": hidden by default; the student may add the badge to a shared profile or evidence record.

foundation.label: Foundation
foundation.use: Setting up and first moves (profile, resume, first band move)

evidence.label: Evidence
evidence.use: Verified evidence records and milestones built on them

apply.label: Apply
apply.use: Applying, interviews, company research, helping peers

learn.label: Learn & practise
learn.use: Courses, practice sets and mock tests

streak.label: Streak
streak.use: Consistency (sunrise orange is reserved for streaks)

badges.name: First Climb
badges.criterion: Your advisory readiness band moves up for the first time.
evidenceNeeded: New verified evidence records added since the last band review
Band change logged in your band history (date + before/after band)

progress.reason: Band-based: readiness is advisory and never shown as a percentage or meter

badges.name: Evidence Builder
badges.criterion: Have 8 verified evidence records across at least 2 skill areas.
evidenceNeeded: 8 evidence records with status Verified (faculty, assessment or employer-confirmed)
Records span at least 2 skill areas

badges.name: On a Roll
badges.criterion: Do one logged learning activity on 4 days in a row.
evidenceNeeded: A completed lesson, practice set, assessment or evidence upload on each day (sign-ins alone do not count)
Rest days you schedule in Calendar do not break the streak

badges.name: Interview Bound
badges.criterion: An application you submitted reaches an interview round.
evidenceNeeded: Stage change to Interview recorded by the employer in Applications

progress.reason: Single event recorded by the employer

badges.name: Streak 7
badges.criterion: Do one logged learning activity on 7 days in a row.
evidenceNeeded: A completed lesson, practice set, assessment or evidence upload on each day
Scheduled rest days do not break the streak

badges.name: Streak 30
badges.criterion: Do one logged learning activity on 30 days in a row.
evidenceNeeded: A completed lesson, practice set, assessment or evidence upload on each day
Up to one scheduled rest day per week does not break the streak

badges.name: Lesson Streak
badges.criterion: Complete a lesson on 5 days in a row.
evidenceNeeded: A lesson marked complete in Learning on each of 5 consecutive days

badges.name: Fundamentals Finisher
badges.criterion: Finish all 3 lessons of Career Readiness Fundamentals.
evidenceNeeded: Lessons 1–3 marked complete in Learning
End-of-course check submitted

badges.name: Practice 10
evidenceNeeded: 10 practice sets submitted in Practice (any topic, each set finished to the end)

badges.name: Mock Master
badges.criterion: Complete 5 full mock tests and review the feedback for each.
evidenceNeeded: 5 timed mock tests submitted in Assessments
Feedback report opened and reviewed for each test

badges.name: Skill Verified
badges.criterion: One skill reaches 5 verified evidence records, at least one verified by faculty or a proctored assessment.
evidenceNeeded: 5 Verified records linked to the same skill
At least 1 of them verified by faculty or a proctored assessment

badges.name: Profile Complete
badges.criterion: Fill all 6 profile sections and have your education verified by your institution.
evidenceNeeded: 6 of 6 profile sections filled
Education record verified by your institution

badges.name: Resume Ready
badges.criterion: Build a resume with all 4 sections and link 2 entries to verified evidence.
evidenceNeeded: Resume in Resume Builder with Summary, Education, Experience and Skills filled
At least 2 entries linked to Verified evidence records

badges.name: Company Researcher
badges.criterion: Complete Company Prep for 3 different companies.
evidenceNeeded: Company Prep brief read and its short quiz finished, for 3 different companies

badges.name: Peer Mentor
badges.criterion: 3 different students mark your practice answers or feedback as helpful.
evidenceNeeded: Helpful marks from 3 different students on moderated practice answers or peer feedback
Marks from the same student count once

badges.name: Ready For Next Step
badges.criterion: Your advisory band reaches Ready For Next Step for your goal role.
evidenceNeeded: Band 4 (Ready For Next Step) set from your verified evidence records
Logged in band history. The badge keeps the date it was reached and is never a score

progress.reason: Band-based: readiness is advisory and never shown as a percentage or meter
